text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a while after the U.A.F. test tournament
had come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A certain change
was beginning to show in <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, during our daily training,
the results are showing up far greater than we had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This change is likely due to her participation
in the U.A.F. and the experience gained there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By rebuilding how she moves her body from the ground up through a non-racing perspective,
it has finally started to bear fruit in her races...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Taking this change into account, I confirmed our future stance on the U.A.F. with <chrname>, and once again resolved to participate in the main tournament!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you very much for taking the time
out of your busy schedule to meet with me today.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, Ryoka Tsurugi had mentioned she "wanted to consult about something," so I was welcoming her as she visited the academy.
choice_data_list: So, what was it you wanted to consult me about...?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Yes. To get straight to the point—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
We would like <chrname>-san
to continue participating in
this year's main U.A.F. competition.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
In the previous test tournament, <chrname>-san
was one of the competitors who captured the crowd's attention.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
And there are many voices expressing great hope
that you will excel in this tournament as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—Fortunately, thanks to the reception of the test tournament,
many more athlete Umamusume have expressed their intent
to enter the main tournament.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Among them are those who say they wish to compete against you as fellow athletes, <chrname>-san.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yes! I am one of them too!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s potential...!
I want to feel it head-on even more and compete against her!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...I am convinced that <chrname>'s presence
will make the 'U.A.F.' a truly superior tournament."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: So, even though you helped us so much during the test tournament, I know this is an impolite request, but—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Please...
Would you consider participating?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Horray!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained to both of them the recent changes in <chrname>
and how they reaffirmed our resolve to enter the "U.A.F."—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh~! That really gets the heart pumping!
That is truly the primal power of sports!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
The level of the U.A.F. will rise even higher!
Training for that will surely lead to even more explosive growth!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
As organizers, we are honored that
the recent test tournament was meaningful
for the both of you as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
We will undoubtedly make the U.A.F. even better.
Please look forward to it.
choice_data_list: If there's anything I can do to help, please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone involved in sports myself,
I see great potential in the impact
the U.A.F. brings right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If this tournament gets exciting, it will surely lead to a better future for myself and <chrname>...!
choice_data_list: I want to make this a great event too!
I want to make this tournament a wonderful one too!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...I am very happy
to hear you say that."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I will consult with you again, and I would greatly appreciate your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"First up are the 1st Qualifiers at the end of June!
Let's both fire ourselves up and do our best!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having formally declared entry into the main tournament,
preparations began for the first qualifying round—
